roleSessionValues.label: Session values
roleSessionValues.help: Constant values this role's row rules read as current_setting('provisa.<name>'). A value the request binds under the same name takes precedence. A role that inherits from this one gets these values, except the names it sets itself. A value may be a ${env:NAME} reference, resolved when a query uses it. A constant takes part in the query, so Provisa's statement records and a source's own logs can show it: do not use a value that must not be seen. ${secret:…} is refused here for that reason.
